sources.title: Democratizing access to large-scale language models with OPT-175B
sources.evidence: Dated May 3, 2022; explicitly releases smaller baseline models including 125 million parameters, with pretrained weights and a noncommercial research license.

sources.title: OPT: Open Pre-trained Transformer Language Models, Table 1 and Sections 2 and D
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The 125M row specifies 12 layers, 12 attention heads and width 768. The suite uses decoder-only Transformers, ReLU and 2048-token training sequences. Appendix D explicitly applies the noncommercial weight license to the smaller baselines. The original Table 1 nominal parameter label is 125M; it does not supply a separate active-count column.

sources.title: facebook/opt-125m configuration
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Exact OPTForCausalLM configuration: hidden size and embedding width 768, FFN width 3072, 12 layers, 12 heads, vocabulary 50272, 2048 positions, pre-layer normalization, ReLU and Transformers 4.21.0.dev0.

sources.title: facebook/opt-125m model card
sources.publisher: Hugging Face, hosted in Meta official model repository
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The card identifies this as a pretrained-only causal language model for text generation and downstream fine-tuning. It states a May 3, 2022 original release and explains that Hugging Face authored this card; the original Meta card is in the paper.

sources.title: OPT-125M distributed weight license
sources.evidence: The exact repository distributes the OPT-175B License Agreement. Its grant is solely for non-commercial research and its restrictions exclude commercial or production purposes; this is the weight license, distinct from the code license.

sources.title: Transformers v4.21.0 OPT implementation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Defines dense attention and two-layer FFNs, parameter embeddings with two additional positional rows, biased attention/FFN linear layers, two affine layer norms per block, the conditional final norm and a bias-free tied language-model head.

sources.title: Transformers v4.21.0 OPT configuration defaults
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The default _remove_final_layer_norm is false. With the exact config do_layer_norm_before=true this includes the final affine layer norm; equal embedding and hidden dimensions introduce no input/output projection matrices.

sources.title: Official OPT pretrained checkpoint listing
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Lists OPT-125M, nominal size 125M and a direct pretrained checkpoint URL. The current link uses v1_20230405, a later package revision that does not replace the original public release date. Weight use is governed by MODEL_LICENSE.md. The Parameters column remains 125M, with no activated-parameter specification.

sources.title: Hugging Face metadata for facebook/opt-125m
sources.evidence: The official repository resolves to 27dcfa74d334bc871f3234de431e71c6eeba5dd6 and was created May 11, 2022, after the original release. Metadata lists PyTorch, TensorFlow and Flax weight files; no weight file was downloaded.

sources.title: Meta metaseq Transformer decoder reference implementation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Defines ordinary Transformer blocks and final affine layer norm. Shared embeddings directly assign output_projection.weight to embed_tokens.weight. decoder.version is registered as a buffer, and attention-mask tensors are not learned parameters.

sources.title: Transformers v4.21.0 shared configuration defaults
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. tie_word_embeddings defaults to true. The official OPT-125M config does not override it.

sources.title: Transformers v4.21.0 weight tying implementation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. With tie_word_embeddings true and TorchScript false, tie_weights assigns output and input embeddings the same weight Parameter, rather than a second independent learned matrix.

sources.title: µ-MoE: Test-Time Pruning as Micro-Grained Mixture-of-Experts, Table 1 and Section 3
sources.publisher: Toshiaki Koike-Akino, Jing Liu and Ye Wang / Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. Table 1 includes OPT-125M but its Active Weights columns are pruning ratios of 60%, 50% and 40%, while original-model perplexities appear next to the model name. Section 3 specifies compression of linear layers in transformer blocks. Appendix C identifies facebook/opt-125m. These ratios for modified models do not state an absolute complete-model active parameter count for the original checkpoint.

sources.title: Neurons in Large Language Models: Dead, N-gram, Positional
sources.publisher: Elena Voita, Javier Ferrando and Christoforos Nalmpantis / Meta AI and Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. The study uses public OPT checkpoints from 125M to 66B and measures whether individual intermediate FFN neurons have zero or nonzero ReLU output. Its neuron-activation frequencies and dead-neuron statistics are not an absolute active parameter count for the complete OPT-125M model.

sources.title: MoE++: Accelerating Mixture-of-Experts Methods with Zero-Computation Experts, Table 4
sources.publisher: Peng Jin et al. / Pengcheng Laboratory, Peking University, Kunlun 2050 Research and Skywork AI; ICLR 2025
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. Table 4 explicitly reports activated/total parameter counts for OPT-1.3B and OPT-2.7B, but does not include OPT-125M. Its published comparison convention cannot be transferred to an unlisted sibling.

name.note: Catalog display spelling corresponds to the exact official OPT-125M checkpoint.

developer.note: Developed and released by Meta AI; Meta is the catalog developer label.

family.note: The exact configuration declares model_type=opt and the paper identifies the OPT family.

release_date.note: The dated original Meta announcement explicitly releases the 125M baseline. May 11 is the HF hosting creation date; neither that nor the later checkpoint package revision is the original release.

open_weights.note: The exact pretrained model has a direct Meta checkpoint link and publicly listed official HF weights. Availability does not imply an unrestricted license.

license.note: Supported descriptive name for the custom OPT-175B License Agreement distributed with OPT-125M; limited to non-commercial research, independent of the metaseq source-code license.

parameters_b.note: Freshly reopened Meta paper Table 1 and official checkpoint listing confirm the nominal 125M size. Retain the previously established 125,239,296 unique configured parameter elements (0.125239296B), derived from the official HF configuration and matching reference definitions rather than checkpoint headers. The configuration and reference definitions remain consistent with that derivation: tied token/output embeddings counted once, full positional table including two offset rows, biases and affine norms included, no input/output projection matrices, and buffers excluded. This pass did not download weights or perform a new tensor census; the supported published nominal size remains 0.125B.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model searches for active or activated parameters and per-token counts did not establish a separately published complete-model count. Meta paper/config/card/checkpoint listing give total size without a separate active count. MERL µ-MoE Table 1 reports pruning ratios for modified linear layers, while the Meta/UPC neuron study measures intermediate FFN activation frequencies; neither supplies an absolute active count for the original model. MoE++ Table 4 lists only OPT-1.3B and OPT-2.7B, so its comparison convention cannot be transferred to OPT-125M. Keep null; dense architecture, total size and FFN sparsity alone do not establish this field.

architecture.note: A decoder-only Transformer with 12 standard self-attention/FFN blocks, 12 attention heads, width 768 and FFN width 3072. The exact implementation has no expert routing or sparse MoE modules.

context_window.note: max_position_embeddings=2048 agrees with the paper training sequence length. Two positional offset rows are implementation padding and do not extend the usable context to 2050 tokens.

modalities.note: Text-token inputs and vocabulary-logit text generation; the exact causal-LM model contains no image, audio or video encoders/decoders.

reasoning.note: The exact pretrained base model has no separately documented dedicated reasoning mode or reasoning-training feature. Prompted text reasoning does not establish a native reasoning-mode flag, and absence of documentation does not prove inability.

tool_call.note: No native tool-call schema, protocol or dedicated tool-use training is specified for this base checkpoint. The documented text-generation interface and external wrappers do not establish a native tool-call feature.

description.value: Meta's OPT-125M pretrained dense decoder-only Transformer for text generation.
description.note: Variant-specific description supported by the paper, exact checkpoint card and model implementation.

patch.description: Meta's OPT-125M pretrained dense decoder-only Transformer for text generation.
patch.notes: Meta publishes a nominal 125M size. The retained 125,239,296 total is derived from the official configuration and reference implementation, with tied embeddings counted once; it is not checkpoint-header verified. No separate complete-model active count was established; published FFN activation statistics and pruning percentages do not provide one. This is a pretrained text model with no documented native reasoning mode or tool-call protocol. Weights use the custom non-commercial research license. Original release: May 3, 2022; HF repository creation: May 11, 2022.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit reopened the Meta paper, official checkpoint listing, exact HF configuration/card and reference definitions. Confirmed nominal 125M and retained the previously derived 0.125239296B total without a new tensor census. Active parameters remain undisclosed after fresh exact-model searches and inspection of original MERL, Meta/UPC and MoE++ research: pruning ratios, FFN neuron statistics and activated counts for other OPT sizes do not establish an absolute complete-model active count for OPT-125M. Both parameter patch values are explicit. The other twelve field assessments are unchanged; no weights were downloaded.
